about: The controlled fault with only the forgetful scan repaired: a freshness check still asks the index once per fact, so a CURRENT look makes many git calls and the verifier must still fail it.

mutations.replace: export const scopesInto = (was, scopes) => ({ ...was, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(scopes).filter(([, v]) => v.hash).map(([k, v]) => [k, { hash: v.hash }])) });
